text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's gone. It's nowhere to be found.
My precious fountain pen, nowhere to be seen...!!
choice_data_list: Where could I have dropped it...?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: —Um, what's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Are you looking for something?
choice_data_list: Ah... Actually, I dropped my fountain pen...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I passed the Trainer certification exam—
it was a splurge I bought as a reward to myself,
a treasure proving my dream had come true.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Something that precious...!?
That's a huge deal. I'll search with you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For now, I decided to retrace my steps starting
from the last place I used it, but……

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... In that case, it seems certain
that you used the fountain pen here
and put it in your pocket.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
The next place she visited was the café, right?
Let's head over there while checking the hallways along the way!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I searched the hallway top to bottom.
I even checked all over the cafeteria.
And yet, I couldn't find it anywhere...
choice_data_list: If we haven't found it after searching this much, then maybe...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Please don't give up.
It's something precious to you, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'm certain that fountain pen held so much within itââ
your dreams, Trainer, your hard work, your memories...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Giving up on it...
Please don't make such a pained face and say such sad things.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Right. The pride I felt when I bought that.
The proof of my dream that braces my resolve every time I use it.
...There's no way I could ever give up.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ――Yeah. Let's keep searching until we find it.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ah...! Isn't that it, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: That thing on the ground over there is a fountain pen!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—!
Thank goodness... Oh, thank goodness...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista is just as happy as I am... or perhaps
even more overjoyed than myself.
After searching tirelessly with such heartfelt devotion――
choice_data_list: Thank you so much, you're a lifesaver!
Thank you so much, you're a lifesaver!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista is just as happy as I am... or perhaps
even more overjoyed than myself.
After searching tirelessly with such heartfelt devotion――
choice_data_list: Thank you so much, you're a lifesaver!
Thank you so much, you're a lifesaver!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Calling me a savior is way too much!
You're exaggerating.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I'm really so glad.
Please keep doing your best with this fountain pen.
I'll be rooting for you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Beaming with a radiant smile,
as delighted as if it had happened to herself.
Her profound kindness truly saved my spirit.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Please, don't apologize.
I just... didn't want you to lose something so precious to you, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...See? I'm so glad we found it.
Just that alone makes me so happy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She truly, deeply sympathized with me――
Her eyes, conveying such heartfelt warmth,
were purely and boundlessly clear.
